At r_* all the polynomial even returns from 3/5 are positive. For N large, start at r_* and take the first parameter where the minimum of the first N polynomial returns becomes nonpositive. The minimum is then zero. It must be the Nth return, since an earlier zero would be followed by -Delta<0, contradicting minimality and continuity. Any fixed r>r_* has finite first passage, so these exact-hit parameters approach r_*. At the critical trap the endpoint pair pushes forward to the single atom at 1/2, hence is not invariant. From 3/5 the odd state is right and strictly positive even returns shrink in the domain 0<u<=1/10; comparing -Delta+u^2(C-r^3u^2) with the pure squaring recurrences proves K=log_2 log(1/Delta)+O(1).
